post.description: JWT student membership and current aggregation consent required. Accepts bounded availability intervals only. Exact retries are duplicates; conflicting batches are atomic. No raw media or identity claims.
Course-professor JWT required. Accepts only local derived delivery events. Frames, boxes, file paths and student identity are forbidden. Conflicts reject the entire batch.
Session-owner JWT required. End the session idempotently; late student and delivery observations are rejected.

Ingest coarse, timestamped missed-content signal events.

Raw webcam frames, continuous raw audio, and screenshots are never
accepted; unexpected fields are rejected by contract validation.
post.summary: Ingest a batch of signal events

post.description: Apply the student's confirmation or denial of missed content.

put.description: JWT member updates only their own provider-specific permission. Separate from signal/aggregation consent. Revocation clears their recovery cache; previously exported external copies are not deleted.

post.description: Opt the authenticated user into anonymous, aggregated participation.

get.description: Authorized course professor, ended session and configured policy required. Returns fixed buckets with safe counts or suppression; unknown coverage is never healthy continuity. Phone observations are excluded.

post.description: Course-professor JWT and released evidence required. Mock by default; live mode additionally requires external-text consent. Recommendations cite approved aggregate intervals; raw and individual signals never reach the provider.

put.description: Course-professor JWT required. Store reviewed/dismissed/resolved state against a current report revision. Stale evidence returns a conflict.

get.description:
Return an anonymous, aggregated summary for the course professor.

Aggregates are suppressed below the configured minimum group size and
never include student identifiers or individual confidence values.
